kaede.title: Two Stolen Bottles
kaede.text: Kaede hauls you up the ladder to the roof of the Lantern with two bottles of wine she very obviously did not pay for, the glass still cold and sweating from the cellar. The tiles hold the day's warmth, chimney smoke drifts past the stars, and her copper tail thumps the roof behind her. "Back in my party, nobody ever had my back. Then this skinny guy in a hoodie jumps in front of a goblin for me." She bumps your shoulder with hers. "Idiot." She doesn't move away, and the tail curls around your ankle.

choices.label: Stay on the roof with her
choices.res: You find the bottle in your hand somehow empty and the stars somehow lower. Kaede's tail never unwinds from your ankle, and neither of them points it out.

choices.label: Pass the conversation back to her wine
choices.res: {N} snorts into the bottle and lets you off the hook. Her tail still sneaks one lazy swish against your leg as you climb down.

image.comp: sitting on a rooftop at night bumping shoulders with him, holding a wine bottle, fox tail swishing
image.setting: tiled rooftop over a fantasy town at night, stars, chimney smoke

kaede.title: Wrong Door
kaede.text: You shoulder open the washroom door and finds Kaede mid-towel, steam curling off her sun-kissed skin, the thin scar on her shoulder pink from the heat. Every single hair on her tail stands straight up like a startled bottlebrush. For one long second the only sound is a dripping tap and your brain emptying itself of all vocabulary.

choices.label: Apologize and bolt
choices.res: Kaede laughs about it for ten straight minutes. Through the door. Loudly enough that the whole corridor learns what happened, and at dinner she toasts you with a spoon.

choices.label: Compliment her
choices.res: She grins, tail slowly settling, and doesn't bother holding the towel very hard. "Smooth, boss. Real smooth." The warmth in her voice outlasts the steam.

else.res: "GET OUT." The towel hits you square in the face, still warm and smelling of her soap, and the door slams hard enough to rattle the hinges.

choices.label: Stand there like an idiot
choices.res: "Take a picture, it lasts longer." You have no idea how she knows that phrase, but she is smirking when she says it, tail fluffed with pride rather than panic.

image.comp: frozen mid-towel in a washroom doorway, every hair on her fox tail standing straight up, wide-eyed

kaede.title: Tail Says Otherwise
kaede.text: Kaede turns up at your door with a bandaged hand and a bright grin, claiming she got hurt sparring "for fun." The knuckles under the linen are split and puffy, and she smells of liniment and sawdust. She sits on the edge of your bed while you unwind and re-wrap it with clumsy care, and her tail keeps brushing your arm, back and forth, warm and soft. Neither of them mentions it.

choices.label: Finish the bandage slowly
choices.res: You take your time over the knot, and she lets you, eyes on your hands instead of the wall. Her tail stops pretending it's accidental.

choices.label: Tie it off and tease her about sparring
choices.res: "For fun," you repeat, deadpan. {N} flicks your ear for it, but her laugh is soft and she stays seated a minute longer than she needs to.

image.comp: sitting on a kitchen table while he bandages her hand, grinning, fox tail brushing his arm
image.setting: inn kitchen at night, a first-aid kit

kaede.title: The Old Party
kaede.text: Kaede's old party leader turns up at the bar in dungeon-stained leathers, trailing the smell of rain and old smoke. He has a new contract, a deep dungeon and a spot for her, if she wants it. The common room goes quiet. Kaede doesn't look at him; she looks at you, ears pinned flat, and waits with her fingers drumming on the counter.

choices.label: "Go, if it's what you want."
choices.res: She stays. Later she grumbles into her cup: "You weren't supposed to make it easy." But she sits close all night.

choices.label: "Stay. Please."
choices.res: Kaede turns the leader down without even looking at him, and the ex-captain leaves with his ears burning. Her tail slaps your leg twice under the bar, hard, happy.

choices.label: Say nothing
choices.res: She leaves for two days without a word. When she comes back, she doesn't mention it. Neither do you. It sits between them for a while, like a bill nobody wants to read.

image.comp: standing at a bar between him and a rugged adventurer in armor, arms crossed, looking at him and waiting
image.setting: busy tavern bar, adventurers at tables

kaede.title: Rooftops
kaede.text: Kaede teaches you to run the rooftops of Hollowmere at night, hopping slate to slate in the moonlight as though gravity were a polite suggestion. You, in your grey hoodie and traveler's cloak, are very, very bad at it. You windmill across a gap, cling to a chimney, and apologize to a pigeon. Kaede crouches on the ridgeline above, hands on her knees, wheezing with laughter.

choices.label: Keep trying
choices.res: By the end of the night you make one jump cleanly. She cheers loud enough to wake the whole street, and a shutter bangs open below them. Neither cares.

choices.label: Fake a sprained ankle so she carries you
choices.res: She sees right through it, ears twitching with delight. She carries you anyway, the whole way home, over her shoulder and grumbling that you weigh nothing.

image.comp: leaping across rooftops at night, laughing back at the man clinging to a chimney
image.setting: moonlit rooftops of a fantasy town

kaede.title: Copper Fox, Kept
kaede.text: After closing, Kaede corners you in the kitchen, where the stove is still ticking as it cools and one lamp burns low. She drums her fingers on the table, stops, starts again. "I'm bad at this, so I'll just say it. I'm not going anywhere. Not for the money. For you." Her ears are bright red to the tips and her tail won't stop wagging. She takes your hand and leads you upstairs, and the door closes behind them.

choices.label: Not yet
choices.res: {N} nods too fast. "I can wait. Don't make it too long." Her tail droops, then perks up again, stubborn.
